sec: Other DM drugs in CKD · p818

items.q: The most preferred GLP-1 receptor agonist named is:
items.exp: GLP-1 RA: most preferred liraglutide. (Book p818)

items.q: The oral GLP-1 receptor agonist named is:
GLP-1 receptor agonists need dose adjustment in CKD.
The most preferred DPP-4 inhibitor in CKD is:
items.exp: DPP-4: most preferred linagliptin (no dose adjustment). (Book p818)

items.q: All DPP-4 inhibitors need dose adjustment in CKD.
opts: False — linagliptin needs none; others require adjustment
True — every DPP-4 inhibitor needs adjustment
False — none need adjustment in CKD
items.exp: Linagliptin (no dose adjustment); others require dose adjustment. (Book p818)

items.q: All but one are the renal-safe sulfonylureas or eGFRD-safe drugs on this page. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Renal safe: glipizide, gliclazide; drugs safe in eGFRD include imeglimin. (Book p818)

items.q: The drugs listed as safe in eGFRD are:
items.exp: Drugs safe in eGFRD: insulin; glipizide, gliclazide; imeglimin (CKD). (Book p818)

items.q: Fill up: Imeglimin is an oxidative ______ blocker, listed for CKD.
Match the following class to its preferred or renal-safe agent — 1) GLP-1 RA  2) DPP-4  3) Sulfonylureas … A) Linagliptin  B) Liraglutide  C) Glipizide / gliclazide
items.exp: GLP-1 — liraglutide; DPP-4 — linagliptin; sulfonylureas — glipizide/gliclazide. (Book p818)
